name: Monreale (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Monreale (a yellow star on blue, outlined yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Monreale, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Monreale arms — yellow star on blue, crowned
star, crown and outline of the arms
